integrity: The proof uses the source's exact definitions of uniform and pointwise provable equality, its formalized program-composition graph equation, its always-valid compatibility under left multiplication, Theorem 1 for strict one-sided failure, and Theorem 3 for the exact two-sided boundary. No finite experiment is used as evidence for the proof-theoretic assertions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a structural refinement of the source's one-sided compatibility result, not a stronger incompleteness theorem. It does not assert faithfulness of the action and does not restore a category or internal multiplication on the pointwise quotient in the recursively enumerable consistent case.
title: The pointwise-provability quotient is a cyclic left act
